title: ResumeParsedV1Payload
description: Payload emitted when service-resume completes extraction of skills from a candidate resume.

parse_id.description: Unique identifier for this parsing job.

candidate_id.description: Identifier of the candidate account owning this resume.

document_id.description: Identifier or storage key of the parsed document.

success.description: True if text extraction and skill matching completed without fatal error.

extracted_skills.description: List of normalized skill keywords identified in the document.

skill_match_count.description: Total number of skill matches found.

extracted_text_char_count.description: Total character length of clean text extracted from the PDF.

processing_time_ms.description: Duration of PDF extraction and NLP matching in milliseconds.

error_code.description: Failure code if success is false.
